test_title: PYST 28: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0488b7c0daf98fa9fa0e852444d1bd45eb81cb2e556cd44c4fcac08bf72271ed.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) IM-PK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc056f3482047183f292cb6af4a7e0bbd7964d9f773124bf2f6fad75108597a2.png] 

Option 2) CG-JD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79212db88f8c0e74fc6a62cda3cf275ee6472968c8d45ae86ec07f4cb44bbdc4.png] 

Option 3) GK-NH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49de5ebbd2f48e5e37a53cc27afde4609ac16d86149a04c8e9ed37b53a299dba.png] 

Option 4) EI-LF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44e53dd7e1053dba79a3cd9873086ec401275574689ff5edfcad8d2529216598.png] 

Thus, out of all 'IM-PK' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
